Minor driver hits bikes, injures senior citizen in Hyderabad

A 17-year-old minor, driving a Baleno without a license, collided with seven parked motorcycles and injured a senior citizen in Hyderabad. The incident was captured on camera. The minor was identified as being 17 years old.
